title: Hearty Beef Lasagne with Pecorino Cream
changes_from_base: A quicker beef lasagne: a tender beef mince and tomato sauce instead of slow ragù, and a no-cook pecorino cream sauce in place of béchamel.
summary: A generous beef lasagne for a crowd, with a tender beef and tomato sauce and a pecorino cream in place of béchamel.

ingredients.item: dried lasagne sheets (curly-edged if you can find them)
fine salt for 4 litres of pasta water (0.5%)
ingredients.note: about 3.25 tsp; most of it goes down the drain

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Boil the sheets
steps.text: Heat the oven to 190 °C (170 °C fan) and oil the baking sheet and the dish. Boil the sheets in 4 litres salted water until al dente, drain, lay them on the oiled sheet and turn to coat so they do not stick. Cut 2 in half.

steps.title: Panade
steps.text: Mash the bread and milk to a paste, then knead in the beef, salt and pepper. The soaked bread keeps the meat tender through the long bake.

steps.title: Meat sauce
steps.text: Heat the oil in the empty pot over medium heat, cook the onion 5 min, add the garlic, oregano and chilli for 1 min, then the beef, breaking it small, for about 4 min until no longer pink. Stir in the tomatoes and simmer 5 min.

steps.title: Cream sauce
steps.text: Whisk the cottage cheese, pecorino, cream, garlic, cornflour and pepper together. The cornflour stops it turning greasy in the oven.

steps.title: Layer
steps.text: Lay 3 sheets lengthways in the dish with a half sheet to fill the gap. Spread over about 360 ml meat sauce, 120 ml cream sauce and 60 g mozzarella. Repeat 3 more times, moving the half sheet to the other end each time, then top with the last 3 sheets, the rest of the cream sauce and mozzarella, and the pecorino.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Cover with oiled foil, set on the baking tray and bake 30 min. Uncover and bake 25-30 min more until spotty brown and 74 °C in the centre. Rest 30 min before slicing.

tips: Knead the panade well into the beef.
Oil the cooked sheets so they do not stick.
Rest for 30 min so it slices cleanly.
storage: Cool, cover and refrigerate within 2 hours for up to 3 days, or freeze portions for up to 2 months. Reheat covered in a 180 °C oven until piping hot (74 °C) in the centre.
